entry.title: Broadleaf Short Robusto — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, cola, dark rum or bourbon (projected)
Occasion: Short full-size smoke, value comparison, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Black pepper, dark chocolate, cedar and earth form the blunt, robust core of Nica Rustica Broadleaf. Connecticut Broadleaf over Mexican San Andrés and Nicaraguan tobaccos is deliberately less polished than Liga Privada, but the 4½″ × 50 Short Robusto promises dense smoke, strong flavour delivery and a useful full-size comparison at a much lower price than most premium Drew Estate lines. Untasted here, so Strength 7 and Quality 7 remain projections and Flavour stays unrated.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the exact 4½″ × 50 Nica Rustica Broadleaf Short Robusto single at A$39 and available. Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
